home.connect.sub: Pull recent games from your account
home.local.sub: Open a PGN from this device
local.browse.sub: Find the PGN files already on this device
stats.accuracy.help: How close your moves were to the best available. 100% would be perfect play.
stats.blunders.help: Moves that threw away a serious amount. Fewer is better.
opening.missing: That opening is no longer in your library.
opening.pointsWon.help: A win counts 1, a draw counts a half. 50% means you break even.
settings.appearance.help: Follow the system setting, or pin the app to light or dark.
settings.background.help: The chess pieces behind the app drift and react to your touch. Turn that off if you would rather they stayed still. It also makes the app a little lighter on the battery.
settings.depth.help: How hard the engine thinks about each move. Deep is more accurate and can spot brilliant moves; Fast is roughly twice as quick and better on an older phone.
settings.language.help: Downloaded the first time you pick one, then kept on the device. Move explanations stay in English for now.
settings.language.failed: Could not download that language. Check your connection and try again.
settings.privacy: Chesy runs entirely on this device. Nothing here is sent anywhere.
review.positionMap.help: How the advantage moved. Drag along it, or tap a marked move to jump there.
review.timeSpent.help: How long each side thought. Moves played in under five seconds count as rushed.
local.scanOnlyDesktop: File scanning is only available in the desktop app.
local.noFiles: No PGN files found in Downloads, Documents or Desktop.
